<strong>A fila fica na memória.</strong>: The queue is in memory. If Telegram MCP restarts, pending deliveries are lost. Catch-up does not replay facts already persisted.
<strong>Cada webhook tem uma fila, entre: Each webhook has a queue, delivered in order. A notice that fails is tried again, with the same body and the same signature, up to 10 times in under a minute, and the following ones wait.
<strong>Na 10ª falha seguida o webhook é: On the 10th failure in a row the webhook is turned off and the deliveries that were waiting are discarded. You turn it back on in Settings, with an empty queue.
<strong>Responda com qualquer 2xx em até: Answer with any 2xx within 3 seconds and do the heavy work afterwards. Any other answer, a redirect or no answer counts as a failure.
